_comment: FSMA 204 traceability-plan components a covered entity must document (21 CFR 1.1315). Reviewable data, not code: when the plan requirements change, these cards are re-approved and the engine follows with no code edit. 'match_terms' are lower-cased substrings used to locate the component row in the customer's traceability-plan sheet (any sheet mapped to traceability_plan_item/answer). Terms are matched after normalizing underscores/whitespace to single spaces, so both template tokens (tlc_assignment_procedure) and plain-English rows ("How TLCs are assigned") match. 'farm_only' components are not applicable to non-farm operations. v2: plain-English synonyms added so real customer plan sheets (not just the demo template's machine keys) resolve to components.
